publication_evidence: Saved 3 November 2026 deployment, test and build records; live behaviour was checked on that date.

items.title: Service metadata review
items.summary: No new service-title or canonical-URL change is evidenced: both previously cited files are unchanged from the saved baseline.

items.title: Allow phone-only enquiries
items.summary: Adjusted existing enquiry forms to accept a valid phone number without requiring email.

items.title: Track accepted homepage enquiries
items.summary: Connected successful homepage enquiries to existing lead tracking and added duplicate-reference protection.

items.title: Restrict analytics loading and update consent handling
items.summary: Restricted existing analytics loading to production, validated tag IDs and added explicit consent updates.

items.title: Filter manual page-view details
items.summary: Added manual GA4 page-view tracking that omits query details and skips private routes.

items.title: Keep course and area details in quote forms
items.summary: Carried page context through mobile quote links and added county/course details to existing contact and booking forms.

items.title: Clarify uncovered training-page headings
items.summary: Changed uncovered training-page titles and headings to describe coverage rather than promise local delivery.

items.title: Correct sitemap dates and retired URLs
items.summary: Integrated the existing date helper, excluded retired course URLs and returned a retryable error when sitemap content is unavailable.

items.title: Separate cookie notice from mobile enquiry bar
items.summary: Moved the cookie notice above the existing mobile enquiry bar and added safe-area padding and page-bottom space.
